content: Node/undici network errors carry a 'code' and sometimes a 'syscall' field. Pre-connection (bytes provably never left): ENOTFOUND/EAI_AGAIN (syscall 'getaddrinfo', DNS failure) and ECONNREFUSED (syscall 'connect', TCP handshake rejected) -- these occur before any request bytes are written. Mid-connection/ambiguous (bytes may have left): ECONNRESET (syscall 'read' or 'write', socket torn down after connection was established) and AbortError/TimeoutError from an AbortController -- these must be treated as ambiguous, not safely retryable, because the connection was already open when the failure occurred.
